propositions: /rerun and recheck-review acceptance currently enqueue forced events only in the process-local asyncio queue without durable backing; process loss causes the request to disappear and reconciliation to skip the revision due to stale local voted state

The approved design resets the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review: 0 via Gerrit before acknowledging, which emits a patchset-bearing comment-added event that serves as the durable marker for reconciliation after restart

Reconciliation must query Gerrit before trusting local dedup; if Gerrit shows no nonzero vote, clear_voted removes the stale row and proceeds to review; if Gerrit read fails, preserve dedup and hold the cursor for retry

The reset operation writes only the fixed neutral value 0 and cannot be influenced by contributor text; eligibility is decided before reset, ineligible requests write no label, and affirmative replies remain label-free via post_comment
